recommendations.name: JITLine
recommendations.description: A fast machine-learning approach that flags defect-introducing commits and the specific risky lines, though the repo is a research replication package with no stated license, so expect to adapt it.

recommendations.name: ISSTA21-JIT-DP (DeepJIT, CC2Vec and LApredict)
recommendations.description: A Python toolkit that re-runs DeepJIT and CC2Vec on a 310K-commit benchmark and includes a simple lines-added baseline (LApredict) that the authors report beats them, with Docker support.

recommendations.name: JITBot
recommendations.description: An ASE 2020 GitHub-app that scores each commit's risk and explains why in CI, but I could not find its source repository, so verify availability before relying on it.
